title: Hetzner Object Storage KOG
description: Configuration for the Hetzner Object Storage KOG blueprint. Installs a RestDefinition (consumed by krateoplatformops/oasgen-provider) that generates the Bucket and BucketConfiguration CRDs and wires the generic rest-dynamic-controller against a Hetzner S3 endpoint. Per-resource CRs (Bucket, BucketConfiguration, the S3 credentials Secret) are applied separately; samples live in the repo's samples/ directory.

nameOverride.title: Name override
nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names. Leave empty to use the chart name.

fullnameOverride.title: Full name override
fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified release name used in resource names. Leave empty to derive it from the release and chart name.

bucket.title: Bucket RestDefinition
bucket.description: Settings for the Bucket RestDefinition and its OpenAPI ConfigMap.

oasConfigMapKey.title: OAS ConfigMap key
oasConfigMapKey.description: Key inside the generated ConfigMap that holds the Hetzner Object Storage OpenAPI document referenced by the RestDefinition.
